judgement.summary: This is a nine-chapter scroll in which a single particle field morphs from noise into a bar grid, a helix, a funnel and finally rest, with each of Rafael's jobs, projects, awards and degrees as a chapter, plus thorough coverage of phone, reduced-motion, no-WebGL and launch-checklist needs. Its greatest weakness is that, having correctly spotted four source conflicts in the first reply, it then resolved them by guessing and locked the guesses in as final — publishing a co-authored paper, a real-time fraud system, an automation platform, an unmeasured 35%, the wrong 40% and the wrong MSc dates — so the most polished part of the plan is also the part that misstates the person's work.
